children: Grok Bot has topped 400,000 users barely a month after launch, giving Elon Musk's expanding AI business an early adoption signal as competition intensifies around autonomous agents. The enterprise-focused tool reached 418,000 users as of September 14, up 24% in a single week, suggesting SpaceXAI is gaining traction beyond the consumer chatbot market.

Grok Bot launched in mid-August and is designed to complete tasks across different apps and file types. That puts it in the emerging agentic-AI category, where models do more than answer questions and instead perform work on users' behalf.
The distinction matters because SpaceXAI is positioning Grok Bot primarily for enterprises.

Meta Platforms' competing Muse agent is aimed more directly at consumers and has generated even faster initial adoption. Muse recorded about 730,000 downloads during its first 10 days following its September 8 launch and reached the No. 1 position among free apps on both Apple's U.S. App Store and Google Play.
The two launches illustrate how quickly competition is expanding beyond traditional conversational AI.
SpaceXAI offers Grok Bot as a standalone application and through multiple AI subscription tiers, giving the company several potential routes to convert adoption into recurring revenue.
The user milestone also arrived alongside Monday's release of Grok 4.7, which SpaceXAI describes as its most capable frontier model yet for coding and knowledge work.

Reaching 418,000 users is encouraging, but investors should focus next on retention, paid conversion and enterprise usage rather than headline downloads alone. Continued double-digit weekly growth would strengthen the case that Grok Bot is finding a meaningful market beyond SpaceXAI's existing AI audience. The key question is whether adoption translates into higher subscription revenue and deeper corporate deployments. Meta's rapid Muse uptake also raises the competitive bar, making monetization and sustained engagement more important than simply winning the initial user-growth race.

title: Elon Musk's Grok Bot Hits Major AI Milestone
